definitions.explanation: Devoting oneself entirely to one thing without distraction. A four-character compound (yojijukugo) expressing total focus and dedication.

examples.japanese: {一意専心|いちいせんしん}、⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ち{込|こ}んだ→打ち込む：04229_uchikomu⟧。
examples.english: He devoted himself single-mindedly to his research.

examples.japanese: {一意専心|いちいせんしん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of practicing with single-minded devotion, I was able to win the championship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一意専心|いちいせんしん}、{子|こ}どもたち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捧|ささ}げて→捧げる：02055_sasageru⟧きた。
examples.english: She has devoted her life wholeheartedly to educating children.

notes:
USAGE:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ used in formal speech and writing. Often placed at the beginning of a sentence as an adverbial phrase. {一意|いちい} means "one mind/intention" and {専心|せんしん} means "concentrated mind." Together they express total, undivided focus.

SIMILAR FOUR-CHARACTER COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{一心不乱|いっしんふらん}→一心不乱：05692_isshinfuran⟧: with undivided attention — similar meaning, slightly more common
- {専心|せんしん}: concentration — the latter half of this compound, usable on its own
- ⟦{無我夢中|むがむちゅう}→無我夢中：05661_mugamuchuu⟧: being completely absorbed — emphasizes losing oneself in an activity
